fix(ci): checkout psdk before Java cache setup

Summary:
- move the dynamic repository checkout ahead of Java setup in check and
  release workflows
- preserve the Node 24 compatible Java and Maven action replacements

Rationale:
- allow actions/setup-java cache discovery to see the target repository
  pom files
- remove the new validation regression found in the first downstream run
  without expanding the workflow scope further

Tests:
- git diff --check
- ruby -e 'require "yaml"; [".github/dyn-workflows/check.yml", ".github/dyn-workflows/release.yml"].each { |f| YAML.load_file(f) }'
